words.meaning: a narrow flat shelf of rock on a cliff
words.example: The young seagull stood alone on the ledge.
His brothers laughed at him derisively.
He called plaintively to his mother.

narration: Before we read on, let us learn three words from this part of the story. {{b1.1}} The first word is ledge. A ledge is a narrow, flat shelf of rock on the side of a cliff. Our young seagull is standing on one, high above the sea. {{b1.2}} The next word is derisively. If you laugh at someone derisively, you laugh to mock them, to make them feel small. That is how his brothers laughed at him. {{b1.3}} And the last word is plaintively. When you say something plaintively, your voice is sad, almost begging. The seagull called plaintively to his mother, because he was hungry and alone. Try using each word in a sentence of your own.
